**1.** [1990] East and West Germany are reunified following the fall of the Berlin Wall.  
**2.** [1991] The Soviet Union dissolves and the Cold War ends.  
**3.** [1996] Scientists clone Dolly the sheep, the first mammal to be cloned from an adult cell.  
**4.** [1996] The F.B.I. arrests Theodore Kaczynski, the Unabomber.  
**5.** [1998] U.S. Embassies in Nairobi, Kenya and Dar es Salaam, Tanzania are bombed.  
**6.** [1999] Ehud Barak wins election over Prime Minister Netanyahu after campaigning to move the peace process with Palestine forward.  
**7.** [2000] Mass panic over societal collapse because of computers not being able to recognize the date changing: Y2K panic.  
**8.** [2001] The Twin Towers are bombed, prompting the United States' War on Terror.  
**9.** [2004] Indian Ocean Tsunami.  
**10.** [2004] Hurricane Katrina.  
**11.** [2007] The first iPhone is released.  
**12.** [2008] The most severe global financial crisis since the Great Depression.  
**13.** [2010 FLASH CRASH] Futures trader Navinder Singh Sarao creates a massive automated sell order triggers a chain reaction among high-frequency trading algorithms causing the Dow Jones to plummet 1,000 points in minutes.  
**14.** [2011] Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak is ousted after protests in Tunisia and Egypt.  
**15.** [2011] 9.0 magnitude earthquake hits Japan, causing the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear crisis.  
**16.** [2011] Civil Wars break out in Libya and Syria.  
**17.** [2011] Occupy Wall Street movement.  
**18.** [2012 THRESHOLD] Mayan Long Count calendar ends, Timewave Zero hits absolute zero and the novelty is unbearable, linear chronology is terminated.  
**19.** [2012 ALEXNET AI BREAKTHROUGH] Starting point of the deep-learning revolution. The Board unleashing its ultimate control weapon to eliminate novelty.  
**20.** [2014] Amazon Echo and Alexa are launched.  
**21.** [2015] OpenAI is founded.  
**22.** [2017 FLASH CRASH] A mysterious multimillion-dollar market sell order on the GDAX exchange triggers a massive domino effect of 800 automated stop-loss orders and margin liquidations, causing Ethereum to instantly go from $319 to $0.10.  
**23.** [2020] COVID-19 pandemic.  
**24.** [2022] OpenAI releases ChatGPT.  
**25.** [2024] Popularization of AI-generated memes...full cultural takeover: Italian brainrot.  
**26.** [2024] Rapid proliferation of AI companion and chat applications.  
**27.** [2025] Albania appoints the first ever AI/virtual government minister.  
**28.** [2025] 1 in 3 teens report some emotional connection to AI.  
**29.** [2025] College Board, known nonprofit which administers AP exams and the SAT, releases a survey stating that 84% of high school students claim to have used artificial intelligence for schoolwork.  
**30.** [2025] Japanese woman Yurina Noguchi marries an AI chatbot that she has generated using ChatGPT.  
**31.** [2025] President Trump returns to the White House, DOGE cuts.  
**32.** [2025] Rise of vibe coding.  
**33.** [2026] Rumors circulate of political figures covering up their deaths with AI-generated media.  
**34.** [2026: NOW] We are in a total purgatory of synthetic, looping novelty decline.
